subject: Music Production
title: Chess Records in Chicago
description: A short lesson to help you apply Chess Records in Chicago.

hook.text: Brothers Leonard and Phil Chess ran a small Chicago studio that recorded electric blues pioneers.

buildup.text: Muddy Waters, Howlin' Wolf, and Chuck Berry all recorded at the Chess Records studio on South Michigan.

discovery.text: The raw, unpolished recordings captured the gritty energy of Chicago's electric blues clubs.

twist.text: The Rolling Stones traveled to Chess Studios specifically to record where their blues heroes had played.

climax.text: Chess Records' catalog became the foundation that rock and roll was built upon worldwide.

punchline.text: Chicago blues recorded in one room became rock's DNA.

quiz.question: Why did the Rolling Stones visit Chess Studios?
options: To record where their blues heroes had played
